name: discover_open_issues
description: Read all open issues from a GitHub repo
input: Read all open issues from d-oit/rust-2026-template
expected_behavior: Auto-detects GitHub from remote, uses gh issue list --state open, reads issue bodies, returns structured list
assertions: Calls gh issue list (GitHub) or glab issue list (GitLab)

name: discover_issues_gitlab
description: Read all open issues from a GitLab repo
input: Read all open issues from my-gitlab-group/my-project
expected_behavior: Auto-detects GitLab from remote, uses glab issue list --state opened
assertions: Detects GitLab platform from remote URL

name: categorize_by_type
description: Categorize issues by type and effort
expected_behavior: Groups issues into feature/bugfix/docs categories with effort estimates
assertions: Identifies issue types from labels or content

name: detect_already_implemented
description: Skip issues that are already implemented
input: Implement all open issues, some may already be done
expected_behavior: Checks existing code against issue requirements, skips implemented ones
assertions: Reports which issues are already done

name: batch_implementation_plan
description: Create implementation plan for batch of issues
expected_behavior: Creates ordered implementation plan with dependencies resolved
